headline: Johannesburg All Share Jumps 3.7% Led by Gold and Tech Rally
summary: South African stocks recorded their biggest intraday gain in nearly seven months, with the FTSE/JSE All Share Index rising 3.7% amid surging gold prices and technology shares.
why: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange is Africa's largest equity market, heavily influenced by resource commodity prices and major tech holdings like Naspers.
why_moved: Rising gold prices and gains in technology shares lifted the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, leading to the index's largest intraday increase since April.
